author: blu
body: Proves Hurricane, the green mirror of Earthquake. "Hurricane deals X damage to each creature with flying and each player." is authored as the HurricaneX marker; the engine deals X (spare mana on cast) to every FLYING creature and both players, sparing ground creatures. Symmetric, so the AI scores it favourable only when it has fewer flyers than the opponent. This demo checks the flyer target set (ground spared), the damage to both boards and both players, the real cast path (X = spare mana, card to graveyard, caster hit too), and the score gate.
